title: SafetyConnect
caption: A one-minute tour of the SafetyConnect app.

title: Home
caption: Your driving score, trips and rank for the last 7 days.

title: Business & personal mode
caption: Pick your vehicle, or switch off business mode for personal trips. They stay private and don't count towards your score.

title: Score breakdown
caption: Tap any score to see how it's calculated: focus, smoothness, anticipation and legal driving.

title: What to improve
caption: See what to work on, like 41 harsh accelerations this week, plus quick safety tips.

title: Trips
caption: Every trip is recorded automatically, with its own score and distance.

title: Trip details
caption: See the route, and exactly where each unsafe event happened.

title: Reports
caption: Weekly and monthly reports track your score, risky events, distance and emissions.

title: SOS
caption: In an emergency, slide to alert your emergency contact, or call 112.

title: Documents & languages
caption: Keep vehicle documents handy, and use the app in your own language.
